name: shani-vo-1
text:
Why do the houses in this village... have no front doors? [short pause] Not broken. Never fitted.
Shani Shingnapur, Maharashtra. Thirty-five kilometres from Ahmednagar.
Walk down the street... and you see door frames. Just frames.
Families here believe the god Shani guards the village... so doors and locks were never needed.
At night, some lean a loose plank across... only to keep animals out.
Then, in January twenty eleven... a bank arrived.
UCO Bank opened a branch here... with a glass front door that is never locked.
But here's the part most people miss. [pause] The cash still sleeps in a strongroom.
And the first theft case on record? October twenty ten. A visitor lost about thirty-five thousand rupees.
So... could you live without a front door?
